metadata.question: Does the green leaf area in China increase during 2017 compared to 2000?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS LAI (Leaf Area Index) or similar vegetation data covering 2000 and 2017 - Collection: MODIS/006/MOD15A2H (8-day LAI) is ideal for long-term comparison - Region: China boundary - Dates: 2000 (full year) vs 2017 (full year) 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LAI already has built-in quality flags; use QC layer to filter valid pixels - No additional cloud masking needed; focus on valid LAI retrievals 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Valid zero LAI (no vegetation): LAI = 0 is physically possible - Invalid: LAI > 10 or LAI < 0 (invalid range), or None/null results - Calculate mean LAI for both years and compare - Check pixel counts to ensure sufficient data (C2 if 0 valid pixels) - If calculation succeeds but result is out of expected range, C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define China geometry const china = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'China')); // 2. Load MODIS LAI data const lai = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD15A2H') .select('Lai_500m'); // 3. Filter for 2000 const lai2000 = lai .filterDate('2000-01-01', '2000-12-31') .filterBounds(china); // 4. Filter for 2017 const lai2017 = lai .filterDate('2017-01-01', '2017-12-31') .filterBounds(china); // Check collection sizes const size2000 = await lai2000.size().getInfo(); const size2017 = await lai2017.size().getInfo(); print(`2000 Images: ${size2000}, 2017 Images: ${size2017}`); if (size2000 === 0 || size2017 === 0) { print('Empty Collection'); print('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean LAI for each year const img2000 = lai2000.mean(); const img2017 = lai2017.mean(); // 6. Compute valid pixel counts and mean values const stats2000 = img2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: china, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2017 = img2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: china, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2000 = await stats2000.getInfo(); const mean2017 = await stats2017.getInfo(); const lai2000Val = mean2000['Lai_500m_mean']; const lai2017Val = mean2017['Lai_500m_mean']; const count2000 = mean2000['Lai_500m_count']; const count2017 = mean2017['Lai_500m_count']; print(`2000 LAI: ${(lai2000Val || 0).toFixed(2)}, Pixels: ${count2000}`); print(`2017 LAI: ${(lai2017Val || 0).toFixed(2)}, Pixels: ${count2017}`); // 7. Validation if (count2000 === 0 || count2017 === 0) { print('No Valid Pixels'); print('C2'); return; } if (lai2000Val === null || lai2017Val === null || lai2000Val === undefined || lai2017Val === undefined || lai2000Val < 0 || lai2000Val > 10 || lai2017Val < 0 || lai2017Val > 10) { print('Calculation Failure'); print('C3'); return; } // 8. Compare const increase = lai2017Val > lai2000Val; print(`Change: ${(lai2017Val - lai2000Val).toFixed(3)}`); if (increase) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
